sharedRules.name: Peasant Army
sharedRules.description:
Roll a die for each Unit with this rule at the beginning of the game, after deployment but before the first turn; platoons held in Reserve do not roll until they arrive.
If the die roll is a 5+, the Unit uses the Elite version for their ratings; these changed stats will be indicated in brackets.

sharedRules.name: Pioneers
sharedRules.description: Cross Minefields on a roll of 3+. If not Pinned Down, may clear the Minefield automatically next turn. Pioneer Units Dig In on a 3+.

sharedRules.name: Mountaineers
sharedRules.description: Teams from this Unit that start their Movement Step adjacent to a cliff or mountain side (or another similar impassable terrain feature) roll a Skill Test. If successful, the team may move using Terrain Dash across the terrain.

sharedRules.name: Motorcycles
sharedRules.description: Infantry Teams from this Unit become Unarmoured Tank Teams with the noted stats, movement, and special rules listed; discard this card at the start of any Movement Step to revert them to Infantry Teams.

selectionEntries.name: 5x ZB24 rifle & ZB30 MG teams (with Motorcycles)
7x ZB24 rifle & ZB30 MG teams (with Motorcycles)

rules.name: Independent
rules.description: Unit cannot Charge into Contact or Hold an Objective, and is ignored for Victory Points.

selectionEntries.name: 4x ZB24 rifle & ZB30 MG teams & 1x Flame-thrower team
6x ZB24 rifle & ZB30 MG teams & 2x Flame-thrower teams
6x Orita SMG teams teams & 2x Flame-thrower teams

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: Brutal, Forward Firing, Slow Firing, Smoke

rules.name: Mounted Assault
rules.description: Team has modified Motivation & Skill when carrying 1 or 2 Passengers; these are indicated by parentheses ().

rules.name: Unit Transport
rules.description: Unit Leader must end the Movement Step within 6"/15cm of the Unit Leader of its Passenger Unit while on table.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
In each Shooting Step, pick one Infantry Team from this Unit. This Team may re-roll one failed To Hit Roll.

If this shot hits its target, target Team must re-roll a successful Save.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card to give Infanttry Teams in this Unit Anti-tank 3 and Firepower 1+ against Top Armour in Assaults until the end of this turn.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
This Infantry or Gun Unit may add a Softskin Transport Attachment; the number of vehicles in the Unit is as follows: 
* Add one Softskin Transport for every four Infantry Teams in the Unit.
* Add one Softskin Transport for each Gun Team in the Unit.

rules.name: Passengers 4, Tractor
rules.description: Team can carry four Infantry Teams or one Gun Team as Passengers.

rules.name: Softskin
rules.description: If a Transport is Destroyed, any Passengers it is carrying are also Destroyed, and all Tranports must be Sent to the Rear immediately. All Passengers must Dismount from this Unit at the same time. Empty Tranpost Teams must be Sent to the Rear.

rules.name: Unarmoured
rules.description: Team cannot Charge into Contact and must Break Off if Assaulted.

characteristics.$text: The Unit Leader in this Unit may re-roll one failed To Hit in each Shooting Step.

characteristics.$text: The Unit Leader may re-roll one failed Firepower Test during the Shooting Step.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card to re-roll any one die you rolled. The second result must be used.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: At the start of the game, after deployment, reposition one of your opponent's Ranged In Markers up to 6"/15cm in any direction.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card before rolling to automatically pass an Armour or Infantry Save (including all re-rolls) made by this Formation Commander.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Increasse this Formation Commander's Command Leadership distance from 6"/15cm to 8"/20cm.
Discard this card: Automatically pass one Unit Last Stand Test for a Unit from this Formation whose Unit Leader is within 8"/20cm of the Formation Commander.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: This Formation Commander HIts on 3+ in Assaults.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Place this card next to a building that your HQ Unit is occupying. For the rest of the game, Infantry Teams in this building have a 2+ Save.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Your Formation Commander may roll two dice instead of one To Hit during Assaults.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Hits by this Formation Commander may only be swapped using the Mistaken Target rule on 4+ instead of 3+.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Your HQ Unit is Concealed when Halted.

characteristics.name: Details

This Unit passes Blitz Move tests on a 3+.
The Formation HQ and any Unit that is making a combined Assault with it Counterattacks on 3+.
